description:
FILED s473t4 (#1501 CHECK 1 round 1, 2026-09-13).  SHIPPED, MEASURED, then REVERTED in the same session â the revert is the finding, and the patch is in this task.

WHAT IT FIXES.  perl-tests/t/test.pl is the 489-line stub the companion's shadow t/ symlinks over perl's own 2069-line t/test.pl.  Three helpers are missing from it:
  unlink_all, unlink_tempfiles   (perl's: `unlink_all keys %tmpfiles; %tmpfiles = ()`)
  is_linux_container             (perl's, verbatim: reads /proc/1/cgroup)
A missing helper is NOT a missing feature: it is an `undef-fn` abort that kills every REMAINING top-level form of the calling file, and the file still reports DIFF, so the loss is invisible to every verdict.  MEASURED with them added:
  t/run/runenv_hashseed.t    9 -> 278 rows (perl: 278), 274 ok / 4 not ok
                             shortfall 269 -> 0; the 4 fails are #1588
  t/op/stat.t                0 -> 44 rows, 42 ok / 2 not ok
                             shortfall 111 -> 67; the new stop is #1589
  = +313 rows produced, +307 passing.
19 companion files call one of the three (io/argv fs inplace iprefix nargv perlio, lib/deprecate, op/getppid gmagic goto magic stat sysio write, run/runenv_hashseed, run/switches, uni/write), so the reach is wider than the two measured.

WHY IT IS REVERTED.  t/re/pat_advanced.t went from DIFF 957/723 to DIFF 0/0 â the whole file, 1680 rows, 957 of them passing.  Its PCL side dies with

    Heap exhausted during garbage collection: 0 bytes available, 64 requested.
    ... bytes_allocated = 1050769584 [97.9% of 1073741824 max]
    0: SB-REGALLOC::GROW-SC   1: SB-REGALLOC::PACK-TN   2: SB-REGALLOC::PACK

i.e. SBCL runs out of its DEFAULT 1 GB dynamic space while register-allocating.  ATTRIBUTED BY BISECTION, not guessed:
  * the emitted CL for re/pat_advanced.t is BYTE-IDENTICAL on both trees (root paths normalised) â so the compiler change in this session is not the cause;
  * my tree, the file alone, quiet box, 900 s allowance: 0/0, THREE times;
  * the `git archive eabff00d` extraction, same conditions: 957/723;
  * the SAME extraction with ONLY my perl-tests/t/test.pl copied in: 0/0.
re/pat_advanced.t does not CALL any of the three helpers.  It is pure compile-time memory: the file is already at 97.9 % of the heap, and ~26 lines of extra code in a module it `require`s is enough to tip it.

NET: +313 rows against -1680.  So the helpers wait on headroom.

WHAT UNBLOCKS IT (pick one, measure first):
  (a) `--dynamic-space-size` as a per-call override in tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm, the way `stack_mb` already is (the default stays "emit no flag", so only the caller that asks changes).  NOTE this is the shared builder for all FIVE runners â the gate runs 8 SBCLs at once on a 12 GB box, so measure the gate's peak RSS first.  DECIDED Â§s437 already has "prove-core MemoryMax scope IN (tools filler, measure the gate's peak first)" â same measurement, do them together.
  (b) find out why a 296 KB generated file needs ~1 GB to compile.  SB-REGALLOC on a very large top-level form is the shape; re/pat_advanced.t is one of the biggest emissions in the corpus, so this is a Target-B question (the IR's function granularity) and probably the better answer.
Either way, re-apply the patch below and re-measure the three files.

THE PATCH (dropped into perl-tests/t/test.pl just above the `# object_ok` comment; comments elided here):
    sub unlink_all {
        my $count = 0;
        foreach my $file (@_) {
            1 while unlink $file;
            if (-f $file) { print STDERR "# Couldn't unlink '$file': $!\n" } else { ++$count }
        }
        $count;
    }
    sub unlink_tempfiles { unlink_all(keys %tempfiles); %tempfiles = (); }
    sub is_linux_container {
        if ($^O eq 'linux' && open my $fh, '<', '/proc/1/cgroup') {
            while (<$fh>) { if (m{^\d+:pids:(.*)} && $1 ne '/init.scope') { return 1 } }
        }
        return 0;
    }
(the stub spells the hash %tempfiles where perl spells it %tmpfiles).
Its guard was Pl/t/suite-stub-01.t â 4 rows, 0 s, loads the stub in a CHILD perl (its `sub ok ($@);` prototypes collide with Test::More in-process) and probes BEHAVIOUR, not existence; inverse-verified failing on a `git archive eabff00d` extraction.  Both are in this session's reverted commit, `git show <sha> -- perl-tests/t/test.pl Pl/t/suite-stub-01.t`.

ALSO NEEDED when it is re-applied: `run/runenv_hashseed.t` needs a 900 s row in baselines/perl-suite-timeouts.tsv (measured ~550 s, the #366 serial re-run agrees; above the 120 s quick cap, so --quick lists it NOT-RUN).  The text is in the same reverted commit.

SIBLING FILINGS from the same measurement: #1588 (hash order is not randomised â the 4 honest fails), #1589 (a failing `open` whose errno SBCL raises kills the program â op/stat.t's new stop), #1584 / #1585 (the two remaining stub helpers, `todo_skip` and `_create_runperl`).


=== DONE (s484d, shipped; bars re-measured s486c on the rebased tree) ===

Two members.

MEMBER 1b -- the per-FILE SBCL heap allowance, in the ONE command-line builder.
MEASURED FIRST: re/pat_advanced.t's PCL side peaked at 977 MB RSS against
SBCL's 1 GB default (95 %), spent by SB-REGALLOC::PACK-TN on one 296 KB
top-level form; the FULL gate's largest single SBCL is 501 MB and the SUM over
concurrent SBCLs peaks at 1,200 MB across 13 processes.  So raising the
default for everyone was the wrong trade -- 527 of 528 companion files need
nothing.  `dynamic_space_mb` in tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm (plus $DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB
and $ENV{PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB}, so a CHILD PCL inherits its parent file's
allowance without a second plumbing path); UNSET EMITS NO FLAG, so every
runner's command line stays byte-identical -- diffed base-vs-tree for all six
spellings and exactly ONE line differs, the registered file's.  Registry
`baselines/perl-suite-heap.tsv` (rel<TAB>MB<TAB>cause) read by
PCLTimeouts::read_allowances -- the SAME parse as the timeout registry, not a
second one.  Guards: tools/t/sbcl-prefix.t 27 -> 39 rows,
tools/t/cpan-scoreboard.t 25 -> 29.

MEMBER 1c -- the three test.pl stub helpers (`unlink_all`, `unlink_tempfiles`,
`is_linux_container`) re-applied on that headroom.  s473t4 had shipped and
REVERTED them because ~26 extra lines in a module re/pat_advanced.t requires
tipped that file over the 1 GB heap and cost all 1,680 of its rows; with the
2048 MB allowance the cliff is cleared (peak 977 -> 923 MB, verdict 958/722
either way).  op/stat.t DIFF 0/0 -> DIFF 94/17: 111 rows where it produced
NONE, 94 passing, and perl produces 111 -- full row parity.  (This task
predicted 44 rows behind #1589; #1589 is gone, s473t5d's #1699 made a refused
open answer FALSE instead of raising.)  run/runenv_hashseed.t 9/0 -> 274/4.
The other 15 files that call one of the three are byte-identical to the base
measurement.  Guard `Pl/t/suite-stub-01.t` (4 rows; rows 3 and 4 verified
FAILING on a `git archive f6b56feb` extraction).

BARS on the combined tree (s486c, rebased onto main 4429126a): gate
`Result: PASS` 243 files / 8216 rows (main 242/8212 + this task's
`Pl/t/suite-stub-01.t`); full perl-tests sweep GATE clean, 0 new / 0 fixed,
TOTAL passing 18681 = 18681 (+0), drops 5 = census, CAUSES 0 of 480 blessed
rows causeless.  Companion `--all --quick --jobs 2`: see the s486c record.
subject: The three MISSING test.pl stub helpers recover 313 companion rows -- and CANNOT be added until re/pat_advanced.t stops sitting at 97.9 % of SBCL's 1 GB heap (measured: adding 26 lines to the stub costs that file all 1680 of its rows)
